y-m-19-12.title: '2x+1/3' ichaverengwa sei muchat window?
y-m-19-12.topic: Kunyora ma expression ane ma variable nema parentheses
y-m-19-12.goal: Simbisa kuti ma parentheses anosarudza kurongeka kwekuverenga mukunyora ma expression ane ma variable, uye unyore zvakare expression iri mumeseji kuti muverengi arege kunzwisisa zvisizvo.
y-m-19-12.material: Muchat window haugone kunyora fraction ine mutsetse wakarara, saka / inoshandiswa kuratidza kupatsanura. Seoyeon akatumira shamwari meseji iyi: "Area i 2x+1/3." Mumathematics, kuwanza nekupatsanura zvinoverengwa pamberi pekuwedzera, uye 2x i product ye 2 ne x. (2x inoverengwa 'two x'.)
y-m-19-12.thinking.0: Sarudza kana mavara akafanana anoverengwa semaexpression akasiyana
y-m-19-12.thinking.1: Tarisa kuti mutengo unochinja zvakadini zvichienderana nemaitiro ekuverenga
y-m-19-12.prereq.0: Kunyora kuwanza nekupatsanura mu expressions ane variable (2x i 2×x, a÷b i a/b)
y-m-19-12.s.s1.prompt: Kana x=4, mutengo we expression '2x+1/3' mumeseji i chii kana ukaiverenga nemitemo yemathematics?
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.0: Muexpression iri mumeseji, tanga wawana zviverengwa zvisiri kuwedzera (kuwanza, kupatsanura) uye uzvimakishe.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.hint.1: Ita zviverengwa zvakamakishwa, wobva waita kuwedzera kwakasara pakupedzisira.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.a: Wakatanga kuverenga 2x=8 wobva wawedzera 1/3. Kuwanza nekupatsanura zvinouya pamberi pekuwedzera.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.b: Hapana parentheses, asi wakatanga kuwedzera x ne 1. 2x inoverengwa kutanga se 2×4.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.c: Wakaita kuwedzera kutanga wobva wapatsanura ne 3. Kupatsanura kunoenda ku 1/3 chete.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.o.d: Munhu wese anogamuchira anogona kuverenga zvakasiyana, saka mutengo hauzosarudzwi senhamba imwe
y-m-19-12.s.s1.r.d: Kushushikana kwekuti munhu asingazivi mitemo anogona kuverenga zvakasiyana kwakanaka. Zvisinei, kana ukashandisa mitemo, mutengo unosarudzwa.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.explain: 2x i 2×4=8, uye 1/3 i kupatsanura saka inoverengwa pamberi pekuwedzera. 8 + 1/3 = 25/3.
y-m-19-12.s.s1.acc.0: Nemitemo yasarudzwa kuva 25/3, asi kushushikana kwekuti vamwe vaverengi vanogona kuyeuka mitemo zvakasiyana kune musoro. Mudanho rinotevera, funga kuti ungaderedza sei kushushikana uku.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.prompt: Pane nzira mbiri dzekuverenga. (가) Kuverenga nemitemo: mutengo we 2x pamwe ne 1/3. (나) Kuverenga zvisizvo: mutengo we (2x+1) wakapatsanurwa ne 3. Kana ukaisa natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12 pa x, wana ma x matatu akasiyana apo musiyano wemitengo yekuverenga kwembiri i 7 kana kupfuura.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.0: Sarudza mashoma, sa x=2, 6, uverenge mitengo ye (가) ne (나) imwe neimwe, uye uinyore mutebhura.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.hint.1: Mutebhura, tarisa kuti musiyano wemitengo miviri unochinja sei painonyanya kukura x.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c1: I natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora x se natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 12.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.ok.c2: Musiyano wemitengo yekuverenga kwembiri i 7 kana kupfuura.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.fail.c2: Musiyano wemitengo yekuverenga kwembiri i shoma kupfuura 7. Verenga mitengo miviri uye uwane musiyano.
y-m-19-12.s.s2.explain: (가)−(나) = (2x+1/3) − (2x+1)/3 = 4x/3, saka kuti musiyano ive 7 kana kupfuura, x inofanira kuva 6 kana kupfuura. Kana x=6, (가) i 12 ne 1/3 uye (나) i 4 ne 1/3, saka musiyano i 8. Painonyanya kukura x, musiyano unowedzera.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.prompt: Kana Seoyeon achida kutaura mutengo we (2x+1) wakapatsanurwa ne 3, unofanira kunyorwa sei pamutsetse mumwe uchishandisa mavara ekeyboard chete muchat window kuti pasave nekunzwisisa zvisizvo? Nyora expression uye utsanangure mushoko rimwe kuti sei wakainyora saizvozvo.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasarudza kana chiri kupatsanurwa ne 3 i 2x chete kana 2x+1 yose.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.hint.1: Isa x=4 muexpression yawakanyora uye utarise kana mutengo wakaverengwa ndiwo waunoda (3).
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa nekuisa nhamba pa x kuti expression yawakanyora, kana yaverengwa nemitemo, inopa mutengo we (2x+1) wakapatsanurwa ne 3 here?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakafungidzira kuti shamwari yako yaizoverenga sei uye wakaderedza nzvimbo dzekunzwisisa zvisizvo here?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Wakafungawo nenzira dzekuita kuti iverengeke nyore, sekushandisa chiratidzo chekuwanza (*) here?
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.0: Ndichanyora (2x+1)/3. Kuisa 2x+1 mu parentheses kunoratidza kuti yose inopatsanurwa ne 3 kamwe chete, saka hapana anoverenga zvakasiyana.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.model.1: Inyore sa (2*x+1)/3 uye uise parentheses kuti kurongeka kwekuverenga kusanzwisiswa zvisizvo. Shandisawo chiratidzo chekuwanza * kuratidza kuti 2 ne x zvakaparadzana.
y-m-19-12.s.s3.modelNote.1: Nzira yekunyora yakachengeteka inosanganisira nechiratidzo chekuwanza

y-m-19-06.title: Kana tembiricha ichisiyana ne 7℃, tinoda kuziva chii chimwe?
y-m-19-06.goal: Simbisa kuti ruzivo 'musiyano ndi 7' oga haurevi kukosha kumwe chete, uye usarudze kuti ruzivo rupi rwakawedzerwa rwunodikanwa kuti rwusarudze kumwe.
y-m-19-06.material: Zuva rimwe, tembiricha ye 9 mangwanani yaiva −3℃ (madhigirii 3 pasi pe zero). Vanoti tembiricha ye 3 masikati yakasiyana netembiricha ye 9 mangwanani ne 7℃. Tembiricha dzose dzinopiwa sedhigirii zvizere (℃). Ngatiti tembiricha ye 3 masikati ive t℃, uye musiyano ndiyo yakakura yetembiricha mbiri ichibvisa diki.
y-m-19-06.prereq.1: Chinhambwe pakati penhamba mbiri pamutsetse wenhamba
y-m-19-06.s.s1.prompt: Tsvaga kukosha kwakasiyana kuviri kwetembiricha ye 3 masikati t kunosiyana netembiricha ye 9 mangwanani ne 7℃.
y-m-19-06.s.s1.hint.0: Ratidza −3 pamutsetse wenhamba uye uverenge kuti pane nzvimbo dzingani dziri nhanho 7 kubva padziri.
y-m-19-06.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga zvakananga musiyano (mukuru bvisa mudiki) pakati pekukosha kwawawana na −3.
y-m-19-06.s.s1.fail.c2: Musiyano na −3℃ hausi 7℃. Tarisa nzvimbo dziri nhanho 7 kubva pa −3 pamutsetse wenhamba.
y-m-19-06.s.s1.explain: Nhanho 7 kurudyi kubva pa −3 ndi 4℃, uye nhanho 7 kuruboshwe ndi −10℃. Kukosha kwose kuviri kunosiyana ne 7℃.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.prompt: Ndezvipi zvimwe zvaungada kuziva kuti usarudze tembiricha ye 3 masikati sekukosha kumwe chete? Sarudza zvose zvinosarudza kana uchiziva chinhu chimwe chete ichocho.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.hint.0: Funga kuti ruzivo rupi rwunokuudza kuti ndeupi pakati pekukosha kuviri kwawawana pachikamu chapfuura.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.hint.1: Pasarudzo yega yega, tarisa: 'Kana ndikaziva ruzivo urwu, ndinogona kuparadzanisa 4 ne −10 here?'
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.a: Huwandu chaihwo hwemaawa akapfuura pakati penguva mbiri
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.a: Kuti nguva yakapfuura yakawanda zvakadini hakukuudzi kana tembiricha yakakwira kana yakadzika.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.b: Kana 3 masikati kwaiva kupisa kana kutonhora kupfuura 9 mangwanani
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.b: Iri ruzivo runosarudza kuti uende kurudyi here kana kuruboshwe kubva pa −3. Runosarudza imwe yezviviri.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.c: Kana tembiricha ye 3 masikati iri pamusoro kana pasi pe 0℃ (zero degrees)
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.c: 4℃ iri pamusoro pe 0℃ uye −10℃ iri pasi, saka ruzivo urwu runoparadzanisawo zviviri.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.o.d: Kukosha kwakatariswazve kusimbisa kuti tembiricha ye 9 mangwanani yaiva −3℃ chaizvo
y-m-19-06.s.s2.r.d: Kuti kukosha kwakapiwa kwakarurama here hakuna chokuita nechikonzero chokuti kukosha kuparadzane kuva zviviri mudambudziko iri.
y-m-19-06.s.s2.explain: Kana uchiziva kuti 'kwaipisa' kana kuti 'iri pamusoro pe 0℃', zvinosarudzwa kuti ndi 4℃ kana −10℃. Kuti maawa mangani akapfuura, kana kuti kukosha kwatopiwa kwakarurama here, hazvibatsiri.
y-m-19-06.s.s3.prompt: Shamwari yakazivisa, "Tembiricha ye 3 masikati ndi 4℃." Tsanangurira shamwari yako kuti sei ruzivo ruchiri husina kukwana, pamwe chete nokuti kukosha kupi kunogoneka.
y-m-19-06.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora tembiricha mbiri dzinogoneka dzamasikati, wobva wanyora mutsara mumwe wokuti sei mbiri idzi dzakasiyana.

y-m-19-04.title: Kuwana nhamba yekuwanza 72 nayo kuti uwane chikwere chenhamba imwe
y-m-19-04.topic: Kuwanza kuita nhamba yesquare (nhamba yeprime factors)
y-m-19-04.goal: Wana kwete imwe chete asi nhamba dzakawanda dzinoita nhamba yesquare kana dzawanzwa, uye utsanangure nemashoko mutemo wavanogoverana.
y-m-19-04.material: Tinoda kuwanza 72 nenhamba yechisikigo a kuti mugumisiro uve chikwere chenhamba imwe yechisikigo (nhamba yakagadzirwa nekuwanza nhamba imwe chete kaviri). Semuenzaniso, zvakaita sekuwanza 12 ne3 kuwana 12×3 = 36 = 6×6. Fungidzira a senhamba yechisikigo kubva pa1 kusvika pa100 chete.
y-m-19-04.thinking.1: Wana mutemo wakajairika pakati pemhinduro dzakawanda
y-m-19-04.thinking.2: Tsanangura hukama pakati pemhinduro diki zvikuru neimwe
y-m-19-04.s.s1.prompt: Nhamba yechisikigo diki zvikuru a inoita nhamba yesikweya kana yawanzwa ne 72 ndeipi?
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.0: Nyora nhamba dzesikweya dziri padhuze ne 72, 64 ne 81, uye utarise kana 72 iri nhamba yesikweya.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.hint.1: Nyora 72 sechakawanikwa chenhamba mbiri, 8×9, uye utarise kuti ndeipi yazvo yatoriva sikweya yenhamba imwe.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.a: Tanga wafanira kutarisa kana 72 pachayo iri nhamba yesikweya. 72 iri pakati pe 8×8=64 ne 9×9=81, saka haisi nhamba yesikweya.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.b: Mu 72=2×2×2×3×3, ma 3 akaitwa maviri maviri, uye 2 imwe yasara. Kana ukawanza ne 2 imwe zvakare, inova nechimiro apo zvose zvakaitwa maviri maviri.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.c: 72×3=216. Iri pakati pe 14×14=196 ne 15×15=225, saka haisi nhamba yesikweya. Kuwanza ne 3 kunoita ma 3 matatu, zvinotoputsa kuita maviri maviri.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.r.d: 72×8=576=24×24, saka ichokwadi kuti inova nhamba yesikweya. Asi hauna kutarisa kana nhamba diki ichishandawo.
y-m-19-04.s.s1.explain: Kana ukanyora 72 se 2×2×2×3×3, ma 3 akaitwa maviri maviri uye 2 imwe yasara. Kuwanza ne 2 kunopa 2×2×2×2×3×3 = (2×2×3)×(2×2×3) = 12×12. 1 haishande, saka nhamba diki zvikuru ndi 2.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga nhamba 3 dzakasiyana a dzinoita nhamba yesikweya kana dzawanzwa ne 72. (Nhamba dzechisikigo kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 100.)
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga kubva panhamba diki zvikuru, 2, uye uyedze kana kuwanza 2 nenhamba imwe kunoramba kuchipa nhamba dzesikweya.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora chakawanikwa chega chega chawakagadzira sechakawanikwa chenhamba mbiri dzakafanana kuti utarise.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c1: a inhamba kubva pa 1 kusvika pa 100.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Kukosha kunowanzwa ne 72 hakusi sikweya yenhamba yechisikigo ipi neipi. Tsvaga chakawanikwa uye utarise kana chingagona kunyorwa sechakawanikwa chenhamba mbiri dzakaenzana.
y-m-19-04.s.s2.explain: 2, 8, 18, 32, 50, 72, 98 dzose dzinoshanda. Semuenzaniso, 72×18 = 1296 = 36×36. Pane nomwe zvose dzine 100 kana kushoma.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.prompt: Kana ukarongedza ma a awakawana kubva padiki zvikuru, unoona muenzaniso upi unofanana? Nyora mutemo nemashoko ako.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.0: Nyora a yega yega yawakawana se 2×(nhamba imwe) uye uise nhamba dziri mumabhurakiti padivi pedzimwe.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.hint.1: Rongedza nhamba dzakaonekwa mumabhurakiti kubva padiki zvikuru, uye unyore nhamba yega yega sekuwanza.
y-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Wakatarisa here kana mutemo wawakanyora uchishandawo kuma a asati awanikwa (semuenzaniso, 72, 98)?
y-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Wakatsanangura here 'sei 2 inofanira kuvapo' nokuibatanidza nenzira inonyorwa nayo 72 sechakawanikwa?
y-m-19-04.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Unogona kufungidzirawo nhamba inotevera inopfuura 100 kubva pamutemo wako here?
y-m-19-04.s.s3.model.0: a ndi 2, 8, 18, 32, 50, uye dzose ndidzo 2 nguva nhamba yesikweya se 1, 4, 9, 16, 25. Saka kana dzawanzwa ne 72, 2 imwe inoonekwa, zvinhu zvinoita maviri maviri, uye inova nhamba yesikweya.

y-m-19-04.s.s3.model.2: Ma a andakawana ndi 2 anowanzwa ne 1, 4, 9, 16.

y-m-19-03.title: Kudhirowa makadhi matatu ane mugumisiro unosvika 20 kana kupfuura
y-m-19-03.goal: Shandisa hukama pakati penhamba yemakadhi asina nechiratidzo chemugumisiro kuwana nzira dzakawanda dzinoita mamiriro, uye usarudze kuti ungaita sei kuti urege kusiya mugumisiro mukuru zvikuru.
y-m-19-03.material: Pane makadhi mashanu. Nhamba dziri pamakadhi i−6, −4, −1, 2, 5. (−6 inoverengwa 'negative six'.) Dhirowa makadhi matatu akasiyana uwanze nhamba nhatu. Makadhi anofanira kuva makadhi akasiyana ose, otorwa rimwe panguva.
y-m-19-03.thinking.2: Sarudza nzira yekuwana kukosha kukuru zvikuru usingasiye chero
y-m-19-03.prereq.0: Kuwanza maintegers (isina nesina, mugumisiro wenhamba nhatu)
y-m-19-03.s.s1.prompt: Kana ukadhirowa makadhi matatu kubva pamashanu aya, mugumisiro unova wakanaka kana makadhi akadhirowa asina ari mangani?
y-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.0: Wanza nyaya dzekudhirowa makadhi asina 1, 2, ne3 rimwe panguva uye tanga waongorora zviratidzo chete.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.hint.1: Verenga kuti chiratidzo chisina chakaonekwa kangani mukuwanza.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.r.a: Pane makadhi maviri akanaka chete, 2 ne5. Haugoni kudhirowa makadhi matatu pasina rakaipa, saka nyaya iyi haigoni kuitika nemakadhi aya.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.r.b: Mugumisiro wekadhi 1 risina nemakadhi 2 akanaka une nhamba imwe isina yakawanzwa, saka usina.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.r.c: Mugumisiro wemakadhi maviri asina unotanga wava wakanaka, uye kuwanza nekadhi rakanaka rasara kunoramba kwakanaka.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.r.d: Kuwanza makadhi matatu asina zvinoreva kuti nhamba isina yakawanzwa kkatatu, saka mugumisiro unova usina zvakare.
y-m-19-03.s.s1.explain: Kana nhamba yemakadhi asina mumugumisiro iri even, mugumisiro wakanaka; kana iri odd, mugumisiro usina. Nemakadhi aya, zvinogoneka chete kana 2 pamakadhi 3 asina (ne0 hapana makadhi akanaka akakwana).
y-m-19-03.s.s2.prompt: Gadzira nzira dzakasanganiswa nhatu dzemakadhi matatu akasiyana ane mugumisiro unosvika 20 kana kupfuura. Nyora nhamba dziri pamakadhi ku a, b, c, kubva padiki kuenda kukuru.
y-m-19-03.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga, edza kubatanidza makadhi maviri asina nekadhi rimwe rakanaka.

y-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Imwe nhamba haiko pamakadhi. Sarudza kubva ku−6, −4, −1, 2, 5.
y-m-19-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Idzi makadhi matatu akasiyana, akanyorwa kutanga nenhamba diki.
y-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Nyora zvichitevedzana kubva panhamba diki, uchishandisa makadhi akasiyana.
y-m-19-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Mugumisiro uri pasi pe20. Tanga waongorora chiratidzo chemugumisiro.

y-m-19-03.s.s3.prompt: Nzira yakavimbika zvikuru yekuva nechokwadi chekuti wakawana musanganiswa une mugumisiro mukuru zvikuru usina kusiya chero ndeipi?
y-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wasefa nyaya dzemakandidate dzinoita mamiriro nechiratidzo.
y-m-19-03.s.s3.hint.1: Verenga kuti makandidate mangani anosara mushure mekusefa uye unyore mugumisiro wawo wose mutebhura.
y-m-19-03.s.s3.o.a: Dhirowa makadhi matatu ane nhamba huru zvikuru, 5, 2, −1, uye uwanze

y-m-19-02.title: Tinogona kuvimba sei nekukosha kwe(−1)×(−2)?
y-m-19-02.topic: Kuwanza nhamba dzisina nezvikonzero zviri shure kwemutemo
y-m-19-02.goal: Siyanisa kuti marudzi akasiyana ehumbowo (pateni, mutemo wekugovera, kududzirwa kwehupenyu chaihwo) anotsigira sei mhedziso (isina)×(isina)=yakanaka, uye gadzirisa kuvimba kwako sezvo ruzivo rwuchiwedzera.
y-m-19-02.material: Fungidzira unoziva kare (yakanaka)×(isina) mukuwanza ma integer. (−2) inoverengwa 'negative two', uye (−1)×(−2) inoverengwa 'negative one times negative two'. Ngatione kuti kufunga kwako nezvekukosha kwe(−1)×(−2) kunochinja sei sezvo ruzivo rwuchipiwa chidimbu nechidimbu.
y-m-19-02.thinking.1: Ongorora kuti ruzivo rutsva runochinja sei kuvimba kwako
y-m-19-02.prereq.1: Ruzivo rwekuverenga mugumisiro une huwandu mumabracket (mutemo wekugovera) uchishandisa nhamba dzechisikigo
y-m-19-02.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo runoratidzwa chidimbu nechidimbu. Nguva imwe neimwe, sarudza zvinoita sezvakanyanya kuitika izvozvi, wobva waongorora kufunga kwako neruzivo runotevera.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pachidimbu chega chega cheruzivo, siyanisa kana zvawakadzidza nyowani 'zvichiita kuti kufungidzira kwako kuve kwakasimba' kana 'zvichikuita kuti ufunge nezvechiyero chekufungidzira kwako'.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.hint.1: Isa mhinduro yawakasarudza zvakananga mukutaura uye uongorore kuti haipikisani neruzivo rwekutanga.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.info:
Ndakanyora kukosha kwakawanzwa ne(−2) ndichideredza multiplier kuburikidza ne3, 2, 1, 0.
3 × (−2) = −6
2 × (−2) = −4
1 × (−2) = −2
0 × (−2) = 0
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Tarisa kuti mugumisiro unochinja sei nguva imwe neimwe multiplier mutebhura painodzika ne1, uye ufungidzire kukosha kwemutsara unotevera, (−1) × (−2).
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kuenderera nepateni nekufungidzira 2 kunonzwisisika, uye kuda kuongorora zvakawanda nokuti hapana vimbiso yekuti pateni inoenderera kunonzwisisikawo. Pateni humbowo chete, kwete humbowo hwakakwana.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: 2. Mugumisiro wakanga uchikura ne2 nguva imwe neimwe, saka unotevera uchavawo 2
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kufungidzira kwakaitwa nekuenderera nepateni yetebhura kusvika kuceli inotevera. Kunofunga kuti pateni inoramba ichienda.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.b: −2. Tiri kuwanza nenhamba isina, saka mugumisiro uchavawo usina
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Izvi zvinoshandisa pfungwa yezviratidzo chete: 'nhamba isina iripo, saka mhinduro isina'. Hazvisati zvashandisa kuti mugumisiro uri mutebhura unochinja sei.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Handisati ndaziva. Ndinofanira kuongorora wega kuti pateni iyi inoenderera kuceli dzisina here
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Uyu ndiwo mufungo wekushandisa pateni sehumbowo uchifunga nezvechiyero chayo. Pateni haivimbisi kuti inoenderera.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Izvi zvinofunga kuti 0 ndiyo 'mugumo'. Tebhura haipi chikonzero chekumira pa0.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.info:
Ruzivo rutsva: Fungidzira mutemo wekugovera waishandiswa nenhamba dzechisikigo (kuwanza huwandu hwuri mumabracket kunoenzana nekuwanza chikamu chimwe nechimwe ukawedzera) unoramba uchishanda kunhamba dzisina futi. Saka
(−1) × (−2) + 1 × (−2) = ((−1) + 1) × (−2) = 0 × (−2) = 0
uye 1 × (−2) = −2.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mushure mekuona ruzivo urwu, kufunga kwako nezve(−1) × (−2) kwakachinja sei?
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Zvinonzwisisika kuchengeta kufungidzira kwako kwekutanga (2) ukavimba zvakanyanya, uye zvinonzwisisikawo kuratidza kuti mhedziso iyi inoenderana nevimbiso yekuti 'mutemo wekugovera unoramba uchishanda'.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: 0. Mugumisiro wekutaura uri pamusoro i0, saka kukosha kwe(−1)×(−2) kunofanira kuva 0 futi
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Izvi zvinotora kukosha 0 kwekutaura kwose sekwakafanana nekukosha kwechikamu chimwe mukati mawo. Chikamu chimwe ichocho inhamba inopa 0 kana ichiwedzerwa ku−2.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Chinja kuita −2. Kana zvikamu zviviri zvose zviri −2, kutaura kunoita sekwakarongeka uye kwakanaka
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: (−2)+(−2)=−4, saka huwandu hauzi 0. Nhanho yekuiisa mukutaura kuti uongorore haisipo.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Zvinosarudzwa kuti i2 pasi pevimbiso yekuti mutemo wekugovera unoramba uchishanda. Kana vimbiso ikachinja, inogona kusiyana
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Izvi zvinotarisawo kuti mhedziso inoenderana nekufungidzira kupi. Kutonga kunoziva chiyero chinoshandiswa nemutemo.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ndinovimba zvakanyanya ne2. Kuti iwedzere ku0 ne−2, inofanira kuva yakapesana ne−2
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ruzivo rutsva rwakaita kuti kufungidzira kwako kwekutanga kuve kwakasimba. Wakasarudza kukosha uchishandisa mamiriro ekuti inhamba inopa 0 kana ichiwedzerwa.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Ruzivo rutsva: Jaemin akati, "Handizivi kuti zvinoreva chii kuva nechikwereti che2원 nguva −1. Kana zvisingatsanangurwi muhupenyu chaihwo, handigoni kutenda (−1)×(−2)=2." Kune rimwe divi, kuwanza uku kunogonawo kududzirwa se '−2 iri 2 kuruboshwe, uye kuwanza ne−1 kunotendeudza nzira'.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Zvinonzwisisika kusarambira mutemo nokuti hapana muenzaniso wehupenyu chaihwo, uye kusiyanisa mabasa ekuenderana kwemutemo nekududzirwa.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Kusava netsananguro muhupenyu chaihwo hakuiti kuti zvisakarurama. Ndinoongorora kana zvichipokana nemimwe mitemo
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Wakawana chikonzero chekugamuchira mhedziso kwete mumuenzaniso mumwe wehupenyu chaihwo asi mukuenderana kwemitemo yose.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Pane mutemo nekududzirwa (kutendeudza nzira), saka ndinozvigamuchira, asi ndinorangarira kuti kududzirwa mufananidzo chete
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakasiyanisa mabasa emutemo nemufananidzo. Unoona kududzirwa sethandizo, kwete hwaro hwose.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Kana kuine nzira imwe yekududzira muhupenyu chaihwo, mugumisiro uyu wakanyatsoratidzwa
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kududzirwa kunobatsira kunzwisisa, asi kududzirwa kumwe hakusi humbowo. Unoda zvakare kuti usapokane nemitemo.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Mutemo usingagoni kutsanangurwa pakarepo nemienzaniso yehupenyu chaihwo unofanira kutorwa semutemo usina kururama
y-m-19-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Hakusi mitemo yose yemathematics inogona kutsanangurwa pakarepo nemienzaniso yehupenyu chaihwo. Mutemo haurevi kuti hauna kururama nokuti hapana nzira yekuutsanangura.
y-m-19-02.s.s1.reflect: Pateni raiva humbowo hwekuti 'zvinoita sezvichienderera', mutemo wekugovera waiva chikonzero chekuti 'kana tikachengeta vimbiso, zvinosarudzwa nenzira iyi', uye kududzirwa kwehupenyu chaihwo kwaiva 'mufananidzo unobatsira kunzwisisa'. Tarisa shure kuti kuvimba kwako mumhedziso imwe chete kwakachinja sei nguva imwe neimwe rudzi rwehwaro paruchinja.

y-m-19-09.s.s1.hint.0: Mupeya mumwe nemumwe, isa 0 ne1 pa x uye uenzanise makosha e ma expression maviri.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.hint.1: Kupeya ine makosha akasiyana, kuedza kumwe kwakakwana kuziva kuti ma expression akasiyana. Kupeya ine makosha akabuda akafanana, isa nhamba dzakawanda kana bvisa mabracket kuti utarise.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.a: Kubvisa mabracket kunopa 3x−6+5, uye kuunganidza ma constant kunopa 3x−1. Ma expression maviri anosangana.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.b: Kuwedzera 2 kuma term ose ari mukati memabracket kunopa 2x+2, uye huwandu ndi3x+2. Dzinosiyana panzvimbo imwe, constant term.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.c: Kuwedzera −2 ne x ne−3 zvose kunopa −2x+6, saka 4x−2x+6 = 2x+6. Ma expression maviri anosangana.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.r.d: − iri pamberi pemabracket inoshanda kuma term maviri ose ari mukati. Inopa −x+4, saka huwandu ndi x+4, uye chiratidzo che constant term chakasiyana ne x−4.
y-m-19-09.s.s1.explain: Kune a ne c, kubvisa mabracket kunopa expression imwe chete. Kune b, 2x+2+x = 3x+2, uye kune d, −x+4+2x = x+4, saka ma constant term akasiyana uye hazvisi ma expression akafanana.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.prompt: Pane expression A = 3x+2. Kana x=2, kukosha kwe A ndi8. Gadzira ma linear expression matatu akasiyana B = px+q ane kukosha kwakafanana 8 pa x=2 asi asiri expression imwe chete ne A. (p ne q ndema integer kubva ku−10 kusvika ku10)
y-m-19-09.s.s2.hint.0: Kutanga sarudza p, wobva wakwanisa q zvekuti kuisa x=2 kupe 8.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisawo zvinoitika kana ukaita p yakaenzana ne3.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c1: p ne q ndema integer kubva ku−10 kusvika ku10.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c1: Nyora p ne q seinteger kubva ku−10 kusvika ku10.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c2: Kukosha kwe B pa x=2 ndi8.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Kukosha kwe B kana ukaisa x=2 hakusi 8. Verenga 2×p+q.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c3: Coefficient yakasiyana ne ya A, saka haisi expression imwe chete.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c3: Kana p=3, ipapo q=2 uye iexpression imwe chete ne A. Iite expression yakasiyana.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.ok.c4: Coefficient ye x haisi 0, saka ilinear expression.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.fail.c4: Kana p=0, iconstant, saka haisi linear expression.
y-m-19-09.s.s2.explain: Ma expression ane kukosha 8 pa x=2 anosanganisira B = x+6, 2x+4, 4x+0, 5x−2. Dzose dzinoenzana ne A pa x=2 chete; semuenzaniso, pa x=0, A ndi2 uye B = x+6 ndi6.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.prompt: Nekuti makosha e ma expression maviri akaenzana kana wakaisa x=2, unogona kutaura kuti ma expression maviri ndema expression imwe chete here? Kana usingagoni, nyora chikonzero, uye unyorewo zvaungaita kuratidza kuti ma expression maviri akasiyana.
y-m-19-09.s.s3.hint.0: Kutanga sarudza imwe ye ma expression awakagadzira muhanho yapfuura uye uenzanise makosha ayo pa x=2 ne x=0.
